scope: revalidation of audit findings not directly invalidated by 2cb47c2, plus changed-path analysis where implementation was touched

findings.evidence: The audited no-force/remote-history protection path was not changed by 2cb47c2. Current git ancestry tests pass; BestEffortPush semantics remain remote protection rather than logical authority.
Current ZombieFenceSpec passes. It continues to test revocation when tracker ownership changes; it does not turn BestEffortPush NFF into a throwing logical fence.
2cb47c2 touched BindingProperties, but current BindingResolverSpec and BindingRatificationSpec pass. The operator-owned binding / repo-only tightening boundary remains enforced.
No 2cb47c2 change introduced L7/path scoping into the shipped egress guard; the prior hostname-allowlist residual remains applicable.

Reaper.java changed for interrupt/stop short-circuiting, but the shape-routing switch and recovery ownership semantics were not replaced. The direct BranchShape/TrackerShape/RecoveryOwner primitives were not changed by 2cb47c2.
